tool_args.rationale: The added long-horizon rows show the predicted reversal and cover the requested forecast scale. Fit the five parameters numerically to the specified sink-coupled dual-horizon law. The prior executions failed because predict referenced undefined train_rows; this implementation stores fitted parameters at module scope during fit and predict reads that state.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; supplied observations span H=0.16 to 23.8 and show short-H positive and long-H negative outputs.
Does not incorporate the supplied sink-gradient signature; model should capture the observed dependence through s_grad.
Not relevant to identification of the supported temporal and sink-coupled law.
